statements: deterministic seeds and thread controls are used wherever they are available
floating-point numerical kernels are NOT assumed bitwise reproducible
an atomically persisted, provenance-valid COMPLETE scientific output is authoritative
resume never recomputes a valid COMPLETE output, not even to verify reproducibility
a corrupted COMPLETE output is never silently regenerated; it stops the run
no metric implementation, inventory or learned model was altered in response to numerical jitter

documented_limitation.mechanism: cv2.Sobel / cv2.magnitude in float32; SIMD paths are not bit-reproducible and the histogram entropy amplifies the difference
documented_limitation.consequence: in a rare near-tie this was sufficient to change predicted-score ordering, hence the selected candidate and the final labels
documented_limitation.status: DOCUMENTED NUMERICAL IMPLEMENTATION LIMITATION - the metric is unmodified

frozen_statement: floating-point CVI evaluation is not guaranteed bitwise reproducible for every metric; rare near-tie selections may therefore be numerically sensitive
withdrawn_requirement: the earlier Stage-4B-4 requirement that a recomputed scientific arm reproduce a bit-identical final selection is WITHDRAWN; integrity now rests on immutable persisted COMPLETE results rather than on bit-exact recomputation

environment_controls.purpose: reduce uncontrolled variation and oversubscription; NOT an attempt to obtain bit identity
